name: Mohamed Arslan — WF-03 Get Content Job Status

parameters.query: SELECT job_id, site_key, operation, status, source_language, target_languages, drive_folder_id, manifest_file_id, content_id, preview_urls, published_urls, scheduled_at, requested_by, approval_required, approved_by, approved_at, idempotency_key, retry_count, last_error, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM content_jobs WHERE job_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT event_type, workflow_name, execution_id, payload, created_at FROM job_events WHERE job_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;

parameters.jsCode:
const jobCtx = $("03 Check Job Found").item.json;
const row = jobCtx.job;
const events = $("05 Load Recent Events").all().map(i => i.json).filter(e => e.event_type);

const nextActionsMap = {
  CREATED: ["validate", "cancel"],
  VALIDATION_FAILED: ["retry", "cancel"],
  CONTENT_READY: ["prepare_assets", "cancel"],
  ASSETS_READY: ["create_preview", "cancel"],
  REVIEW_PENDING: ["approve", "reject", "cancel"],
  APPROVED: ["publish_now", "schedule", "cancel"],
  SCHEDULED: ["cancel"],
  PUBLISHED: ["verify", "rollback"],
  FAILED: ["retry", "cancel"],
  COMPLETED: [],
  CANCELLED: []
};

const nextAllowedActions = nextActionsMap[row.status] || ["cancel"];

return {
  success: true,
  jobId: row.job_id,
  status: row.status,
  message: "Content job status retrieved successfully.",
  data: {
    siteKey: row.site_key,
    operation: row.operation,
    sourceLanguage: row.source_language,
    targetLanguages: row.target_languages,
    driveFolderId: row.drive_folder_id,
    contentId: row.content_id,
    previewUrls: row.preview_urls,
    publishedUrls: row.published_urls,
    scheduledAt: row.scheduled_at,
    requestedBy: row.requested_by,
    approvalRequired: row.approval_required,
    approvedBy: row.approved_by,
    approvedAt: row.approved_at,
    retryCount: row.retry_count,
    lastError: row.last_error,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
    completedAt: row.completed_at,
    recentEvents: events
  },
  warnings: [],
  errors: [],
  nextAllowedActions
};

parameters.content:
WF-03 Get Content Job Status
Loads job state and recent events from operational PostgreSQL DB. Returns full normalized response with allowed next actions.
